title: Muv-Luv Alternative: Against the BETA
alt: At sunset a humanoid war machine flies low over a burnt plain on blue jets and raises a long sword. It fires a gun at a giant creature that stands on ten long legs. Red and green creatures run across the plain, lasers cross the dark red sky, and tall spires stand on the horizon.
summary: A painting of a scene from Muv-Luv Alternative in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is a battle from Muv-Luv Alternative, a visual novel by âge. Aliens named BETA have taken most of Eurasia. A Tactical Surface Fighter attacks a Fort-class, the largest of the BETA.
Destroyer-class, Grappler-class and Tank-class BETA run across the plain. Laser-class BETA shoot at shells in the sky, and a Hive stands on the horizon. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
